title: Sanctifying Work of the Spirit
definition: The sanctifying work of the Spirit is His ministry of making believers holy and conforming them to the likeness of Christ.
summary: The Holy Spirit progressively forms holiness and Christlike character in believers.
christFocus: Jesus sanctifies His people by His Word and Spirit, making them more like Himself.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Sanctification is impossible apart from the Holy Spirit. He convicts sin, renews desires, empowers obedience, produces fruit, and conforms believers to Christ.

The Spirit does not sanctify by bypassing Scripture or human responsibility. He works through the Word, prayer, fellowship, repentance, discipline, and obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers try to become holy through self-effort alone. This doctrine matters because holiness is God's work in and through His people.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Cooperate with the Spirit's work. Put sin to death, walk in obedience, receive correction, and trust Him for ongoing transformation.
